Meet Perla

Hi, I'm Perla — your softie bestie

I'm an Orlando-based creator sharing soft-girl beauty, hair, faith and real life. By day I work with little ones as a speech-language pathology assistant; online, this is my corner for confidence without performance and finding something lovely in an ordinary Tuesday.

Whether we're talking through a new protective style, a lip combo that finally works, or a morning reminder you needed to hear — you're always welcome here.
